_comment: Copied to <your-projects-root>/<project>/market-signal/config.json on the first run. Values given in chat win, then this file, then project-context. No script reads this file: the model writes window, caps and sources into plan.json and passes the thresholds as flags. language: ISO codes comma-separated or both. recency_days: window length; every quote must be dated inside it. depth sets the caps per collector job (quick 10 records and 2 pages, standard 25 and 3, deep 50 and 5); caps.records_per_job and caps.pages_per_job override it (a plan without caps runs at 50 and 3). sources.include: communities the plan must cover, as {"source": "reddit", "subreddit": "..."}, {"source": "discourse", "host": "..."}, {"source": "stackexchange", "site": "..."}, {"source": "appstore", "app_id": "...", "country": ".."}. sources.exclude: job ids or hosts never to use (also kept in sources-rejected.md). escalation: a pain escalates at min_authors distinct authors across min_communities communities, counting the speakers listed (--min-authors, --min-communities of compute_signals.py and build_handoff.py; counted_speakers is --speakers of compute_signals.py and build_handoff.py, comma-separated, among user, practitioner, vendor, press, other; an unknown value exits 2). watch.enabled: collect only what is new since state/seen.json and write changes.md against the previous run; rise_ratio and min_delta set what counts as rising (distinct authors per 30 days; --rise-ratio, --min-delta of diff_runs.py). The first watch run has no state file and runs collect.py with --seen alone. valid_days: how long consumers treat the sidecar as fresh (--valid-days of build_handoff.py, which sets valid_until). Optional: a "tools" object (same keys as shared/tools.example.json) overrides the project's tools.json for this agent; paid providers stay off unless the founder sets them.
